title: 12 被欺负了，的叶修
slug: 全职高手首先你不会被一见钟情
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

周珈蓝合上手机，小小地打了个哈欠。

今夜世界纷纷扰扰，但好像都跟她没关系，只有电脑屏幕幽微的蓝光照在她脸上，她蜷缩在电竞椅上，衣服不大合身所以露出很长一段雪白的手腕，像海水里的小美人鱼。

她在思索要不要向张佳乐开口借钱，因为跟孙翔拥抱被拍到了，如果现在去找张佳乐，就会被猜到孙翔怀里那个女孩是她。

张佳乐会怎么想，周珈蓝不清楚也不在乎。

她只是很讨厌在别人面前暴露自己的秘密，虽然这个秘密小到似乎不值得一提。

换个人……？

周珈蓝不确定地想。

叶修在这个时候敲她隔壁的电脑桌。

“扣扣。”声音像Q.Q里好友上线。

周珈蓝扭头看见他，手上端着一碗泡面，红烧牛肉味的，泡面上冒出来的热气笼罩着他的手，手指很漂亮，苍白纤长，像艺术品，应该被陈列在上了百万保险的玻璃橱窗里。

他来这里……做什么？

周珈蓝眼睛里冒出茫然。

“给你的。”叶修把泡面放在桌子上，里面还放了一根肠，这在网吧算豪华套餐。

周珈蓝紧张地站起来，局促道，“谢谢……谢谢前辈。”

声音像绷紧的弦，细声细气。

叶修惊讶了一下，“你认识我？”

周珈蓝一手按住口罩，紧张地点头，手指蜷缩了一下，把口罩摘下来，“我是越云战队新人周珈蓝——”

“停停停。”叶修制止她，让她把口罩戴上。

他也不是全无私心，这张脸露出来冲击感实在太强，毕竟是一见钟情的小女神，容易让他说着说着就忘词。

“前辈……”周珈蓝戴好口罩，怯怯地又叫了一声。

叶修感到头疼，他不大擅长跟这样的小女孩打交道，像玻璃像玉石，话说重了好像就不行。

倒也不是不能说，看她样子也不像是很在乎，叶修对她这种小女孩儿其实很熟悉，跟苏沐秋一起的时候在网吧里见过很多，无家可归，低自尊，讨好感，逆来顺受。

她身上没有那种尖锐的神经质，但叶修觉得这更糟糕了，不会保护自己在她那种处境下不是什么好事儿。

他不在想下去，克制住自己的思维，看出来归看出来，继续下去臆测人家的隐私，那就不对了。

归根结底只是舍不得对她说重话，怕她哗啦一声碎了。

他酝酿了一下，尽可能和气地说，“你刚成年吧？不要在外面待太晚。”

但是现在让她一个人走？

“有地方去吗，我送你回去。”

周珈蓝……摇了摇头。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Zhou Jialan closed the phone and yawned slightly.

There was a lot of noise in the world tonight, but it seemed that it had nothing to do with her. Only the faint blue light of the computer screen shone on her face. She was curled up on the gaming chair. Her clothes didn't fit well, so a long section of her white wrist was exposed, like a little mermaid in the sea.

She was thinking about whether to borrow money from Zhang Jiale, because she was photographed hugging Sun Xiang. If she went to Zhang Jiale now, she would be guessed that the girl in Sun Xiang's arms was her.

What Zhang Jiale would think, Zhou Jialan didn't know and didn't care.

She just hated having her secret exposed in front of others, even though the secret was so small that it didn't seem worth mentioning.

Someone else...?

Zhou Jialan thought uncertainly.

Ye Xiu knocked on the computer desk next to her at this time.

"KouKou." The voice sounded like a friend coming online on Q.Q.

Zhou Jialan turned around and saw him. He was holding a bowl of instant noodles in his hand, which tasted like braised beef. The heat from the instant noodles enveloped his hand. His fingers were beautiful, pale and slender, like works of art. They should be displayed in a glass case with a million-dollar insurance.

What is he doing here...?

Zhou Jialan's eyes were filled with confusion.

"For you." Ye Xiu put the instant noodles on the table with a piece of sausage inside. This was considered a luxury set meal in an Internet cafe.

Zhou Jialan stood up nervously and said awkwardly, "Thank you...thank you, senior."

The sound is like a taut string, soft and breathy.

Ye Xiu was surprised, "You know me?"

Zhou Jialan held the mask with one hand, nodded nervously, curled his fingers, and took off the mask, "I am Zhou Jialan, the newcomer of Team Yueyun——"

"Stop, stop, stop." Ye Xiu stopped her and asked her to put on the mask.

He is not completely selfless. The impact of this face is too strong. After all, she is a little goddess who falls in love at first sight. It is easy for him to forget his words while talking.

"Senior..." Zhou Jialan put on his mask and called out again timidly.

Ye Xiu felt a headache. He was not very good at dealing with such little girls, who were like glass and jade. He seemed to be unable to speak harsh words.

It's not that he can't say it, she doesn't look like he cares much. Ye Xiu is actually very familiar with little girls like her. When he was with Su Muqiu, he saw many of them in Internet cafes. They were homeless, had low self-esteem, had a sense of pleasing, and were submissive.

She didn't have that sharp nervousness, but Ye Xiu felt that this was even worse. Not being able to protect himself was not a good thing in her situation.

He stopped thinking about it and restrained his thinking. If he saw it, he would see it. It would be wrong to continue to speculate on other people's privacy.

In the final analysis, I just couldn't bear to say harsh words to her, for fear that she would break into pieces with a crash.

He pondered for a while and said as kindly as possible, "You have just come of age, right? Don't stay out too late."

But let her go alone now?

"If you have somewhere to go, I'll take you back."

Zhou Jialan... shook his head.
